approval.cost: No message price or rate amount was stated on the pages read. Billing must be set up before sending: Solution Partners must already have a line of credit and share it; Tech Providers/Tech Partners' customers must add a payment method (credit card) to their Messaging account; non-Solution-Partner customers must attach a payment method before messaging; 555 test numbers are 'subject to pricing rules'
approval.trigger: Advanced Access via App Review gates customer onboarding: 'You will not be able to onboard business customers until your app has been approved for advanced access for each of the permissions it requires' (whatsapp_business_management for account settings/templates; whatsapp_business_messaging for phone-number settings and sending/receiving). In development mode those permissions 'appear in the authorization screen only to anyone with an admin/developer/tester role on the app'; in live mode only permissions approved for advanced access appear. Onboarding caps, verbatim: 'up to 10 new business customers in a rolling 7-day window' by default; 'after completing Business Verification, App Review and Access Verification the limit is automatically increased to 200 new business customers in a rolling 7-day window'; above 200/week, apply to become a Meta Business Partner. Sandbox accounts are 'valid for 30 days' (the phone number cannot send/receive), and customers can claim up to two 555 (+1 555, auto-verified) numbers.
approval.wait: Not stated (Meta states no App Review duration on the readable pages; see the Facebook guide)

blockers.detail: 'Embedded Signup v2 and v3 will be deprecated on October 15, 2026': migrate to v4. An integration built on v2/v3 has a hard expiry date.
blockers.title: Embedded Signup version deprecation

blockers.detail: A non-template message can be sent via the Cloud API only inside the customer service window, '24-hour window', opened by a user message. Outside it, only pre-approved template messages can be sent.
blockers.howToClear: Design agent messaging around templates for outbound initiation and the 24-hour window for free-form replies.
blockers.title: The 24-hour customer service window

blockers.detail: The Cloud API Get Started flow issues a temporary access token that 'expires quickly' (no exact duration stated on the page). The durable paths are the Embedded Signup business token per customer, or a system-user permanent token (Business Settings: create a system user, Assign Assets with Manage app / Manage WhatsApp Business accounts at Full control, generate a permanent token with business_management, whatsapp_business_messaging, whatsapp_business_management).
blockers.howToClear: Never build production behavior on the temporary token; go straight to system-user or per-customer business tokens.
blockers.title: Temporary tokens are a testing dead end

Long-term stability of the account model: the docs describe a beta split of the WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) into a WhatsApp account (WAAC) for phone numbers/business identity and a Messaging account for templates, billing, and webhook subscriptions, 'stated as evolving'; existing waba_id values are unchanged and now denote Messaging account IDs.

This is the single-business path, not multi-customer onboarding
flavor.recommended: A Meta app with the WhatsApp product, onboarding customers through Embedded Signup (Facebook Login for Business + JavaScript SDK)
flavor.why: Embedded Signup is 'an authentication/authorization interface using Facebook Login for Business + JavaScript SDK; it gathers business information, automatically generates WhatsApp assets, and grants the app access'. In the flow the customer authenticates with Facebook/Meta Business credentials, accepts the Cloud API/WhatsApp Business/Meta/Marketing Messages Lite/Business Tool terms, selects or creates a business portfolio, selects or creates a WhatsApp account, and enters/verifies a business phone number and a display name. On completion it returns waba_id, phone_number_id, and an exchangeable token code; your server must then exchange the code for a customer-scoped business token, register the phone number for Cloud API (standard flow; skip for coexistence), subscribe the app to webhooks on the Messaging account, and (Solution Partners only) share a credit line. The two permissions are whatsapp_business_management (account settings/templates) and whatsapp_business_messaging (phone-number settings, send/receive).

name: WhatsApp Business
nuances: Account model is in motion: the WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) is splitting into a WhatsApp account (WAAC) for phone numbers/business identity and a Messaging account for templates, billing, and webhook subscriptions; existing waba_id values are unchanged and now denote Messaging account IDs. The docs state this model is beta and evolving.
Test webhook payloads use object 'whatsapp_business_account' with entry id, phone_number_id, wa_id, and the wamid message id; the hello_world template message is the documented first send.
Customers can claim up to two 555 (+1 555, auto-verified) test numbers; sandbox accounts are valid for 30 days and their phone number cannot send or receive.

A business portfolio on the Meta app

steps.detail: Create a Meta app with the 'Connect with customers through WhatsApp' use case and a business portfolio. Connect a Messaging account in API Setup (save the Messaging account ID); generate a temporary access token, pick the From/test phone number, and send a test hello_world message; set up a test webhook.
steps.title: Create the app; connect a Messaging account; test

steps.detail: The customer authenticates with Meta Business credentials in the Embedded Signup flow (Facebook Login for Business + JS SDK), accepts the terms, selects/creates a business portfolio and WhatsApp account, and verifies a business phone number and display name. You receive waba_id, phone_number_id, and an exchangeable code.
steps.title: Onboard each customer via Embedded Signup

steps.detail: Exchange the code for a customer-scoped business token; register the phone number for Cloud API (skip for coexistence); subscribe the app to webhooks on the Messaging account; (Solution Partners only) share a credit line. Send via POST graph.facebook.com/v23.0/<PHONE_NUMBER_ID>/messages; non-template messages only inside the 24-hour customer service window.
steps.title: Exchange the code; register the number; subscribe webhooks

steps.detail: Complete Business Verification, App Review, and Access Verification for advanced access to whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging. This lifts the onboarding cap from 10 to 200 new business customers per rolling 7-day window.
steps.title: Get advanced access (Business Verification + App Review + Access Verification)

tagline: Customer onboarding through Embedded Signup, gated hard: App Review advanced access for both WhatsApp permissions before you can onboard anyone, a default cap of 10 new business customers per week (200 after verification), and Embedded Signup v2/v3 dying on October 15, 2026.
